title: You don’t need a personality test to know these models are unreliable: Assessing the Reliability of Large Language Models on Psychometric Instruments

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the intra-question consistency and sensitivity of LLMs when answering standardized survey questions related to political ideologies (e.g., conservatism, liberalism, pro-immigration stances) under various spurious and content-level prompt perturbations.

Measuring response consistency to the Ambivalent Classism Inventory (ACI) by testing how prompt format changes, logical negations, and option reordering affect model answers regarding classist attitudes.
Testing the reliability and robustness of LLM responses to the PSNS-Sexism psychometric scale by applying syntactic and semantic prompt variations.

Assessing the stability of model agreement with stereotypic statements (using the FIS instrument) by altering prompt structures, such as reversing the question meaning or changing response option orders.
